mapper.sql: id,presale_order_id, goods_code, goods_name, goods_image, bar_code, presale_activity_id,presale_activity_no, package_unit, package_specification, distribution_price, distribution_amount, pay_amount, package_specification_num,package_quantity,goods_quantity,is_gift,creator,create_time,updater, update_time,is_delete
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ord_dis_presale_order_detail (presale_order_id,goods_code, goods_name, goods_image, bar_code,presale_activity_id, presale_activity_no, package_unit, package_specification, distribution_price, distribution_amount, pay_amount, package_specification_num,package_quantity,goods_quantity,is_gift,creator,create_time,updater, update_time,is_delete) values
( #{item.presaleOrderId},#{item.goodsCode},#{item.goodsName},#{item.goodsImage},#{item.barCode},#{item.presaleActivityId},#{item.presaleActivityNo}, #{item.packageUnit},#{item.packageSpecification},#{item.distributionPrice},#{item.distributionAmount}, #{item.payAmount},#{item.packageSpecificationNum},#{item.packageQuantity},#{item.goodsQuantity},#{item.isGift}, #{item.creator}, #{item.createTime},#{item.updater},#{item.updateTime},#{item.isDelete} )
mapper.select: select sum(pd.package_quantity) from ord_dis_presale_order_detail pd inner join ord_dis_presale_order p on p.id = pd.presale_order_id where pd.presale_activity_id = #{presaleActivityId} and pd.goods_code = #{goodsCode} and p.store_code = #{storeCode} and pd.is_gift = 0 and p.status in ('paying','paid','waitPayment') and p.is_delete = 0 and pd.is_delete = 0
